input: Search the web for "summer childcare" and school-age summer care for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.
searches: Christine Avery learning center summer camp 2026 Asheville

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Summer day camps and school-age childcare; year-round care options include summer coverage.

candidates.name: Eliada Homes
candidates.note: Summer care Monday–Friday, 7 a.m.–5:30 p.m., for rising first graders through age 12; junior volunteers ages 13–16.

candidates.name: Childcare Network
candidates.note: School-age summer camp and school-break care; Asheville locations on Weaverville Highway and Sardis Road.

candidates.name: Kiddie Academy of Asheville
candidates.note: CampVentures summer-themed childcare program for ages 2–12.

candidates.name: Kids Garden Asheville
candidates.note: Weekly summer programs for ages 3 and up, with flexible scheduling and a four-hour childcare maximum.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Ten weeks of summer camps for children and teens, plus summer evening activities and skill programs.

candidates.name: Children First/Communities In Schools of Buncombe County
candidates.note: Six-week summer enrichment camp for rising kindergarten through sixth-grade children.

candidates.name: Evergreen Community Charter School
candidates.note: Operates Evergreen Summer Adventures, open to area children entering kindergarten through ninth grade.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Movement
candidates.note: Movers and Shakers summer camp advertised for 2026, with weekly themes and community-focused activities.

candidates.name: Asheville Montessori School
candidates.note: Themed Montessori summer camps advertised for 2026, including STEAM activities.

candidates.name: Growing Wild Forest School
candidates.note: Weekly nature-immersion summer care for ages 3–6, Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Camp Ruach, teen leadership programming and inclusive Camp Tikvah; 2027 camp begins June 14.

candidates.name: Christine W. Avery Learning Center
candidates.note: School-age summer camp with STEM, field trips and outdoor play; also offers the teen S.T.A.R.S. program.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Montessori
candidates.note: Summer camps for ages 3–6, with before-camp care from 8–9 a.m. and after-camp care from 3–5 p.m.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Recreation & Parks
candidates.note: Weekly June–August summer camp for rising first through sixth graders, with outings, crafts and STEM projects.

candidates.name: The Goddard School of Asheville (Biltmore Lake)
candidates.note: Summer with Goddard is a 12-week childcare program featuring outdoor play and learning for children through age 6.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Yoga
candidates.note: Six weeks of yoga and mindfulness summer camp for ages 5–10 were offered in 2025.

candidates.name: Asheville Christian Academy
candidates.note: School-operated summer day camps advertised for 2026.

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: Youth summer camp offering both day and overnight programs.
